segments.name: Theme Parks
segments.description: Owns or licenses theme parks that sell admission, food, merchandise and special events to guests, with animal exhibits, rides and shows.
segments.evidence: Each theme park has been identified as an operating segment and meets the criteria for aggregation due to similar economic characteristics.

revenueModel.text: Guests pay for admission to the theme parks and for food, merchandise and other items they buy inside the parks.
revenueModel.evidence: The Company generates revenue primarily from selling admission to its theme parks and from purchases of food, merchandise and other items, primarily within its theme parks.
